items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: I don't remember them people. I heard of them, yeah.

ctx.x: Man, they had both people who sing the blues out of them. I couldn't remember. Oh, I don't know.

Did you ever hear any of the singers from away from here that came in the theaters like Ma Rainey, or say Mamie Smith, or different ones that might have come through here singing at a theater, or on a show, or anything?
I don't remember them people. I heard of them, yeah. As many I went and seen, I couldn't call a name. I wasn't seen at different theaters.
